brokers.name: Whitepages
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Honors deletion requests from all US residents. CA residents get CCPA language.
brokers.notes: One of the highest-traffic people-search sites. Listing appears prominently in Google results for name + phone searches. Opt-out form requires first/last name, city, state, and phone number. No account needed.

brokers.name: Spokeo
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Honors deletion requests from all US residents.
brokers.notes: Requires CAPTCHA solve during submission — route to captcha-handoff mechanism. Agent pre-fills name, email, and listing URL; user completes CAPTCHA and submits. Email confirmation link is sent after submission.

brokers.name: BeenVerified
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: PeopleConnect's centralized opt-out covers BeenVerified, PeopleFinders, Intelius, US Search, and TruthFinder. File once at the centralized URL.
brokers.notes: Part of the PeopleConnect network. Use the centralized opt-out at opt.peopleconnect.us rather than this URL for FR-2.3 consolidated owner handling. This URL is kept for individual fallback only.

brokers.name: Radaris
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: No web opt-out form; deletion must be requested by email. Include full name, phone number, and URL of the listing in the email.
brokers.notes: Does not have a self-service opt-out form. Email request is the only path. Use render_email.py to draft the deletion request. Turnaround is typically 7–14 days; follow up if no confirmation within 30.

brokers.name: InfoTracer
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: CA-registered data broker. CA DROP path covers this broker for CA residents.
brokers.notes: CA-registered broker used for the ca-drop eval path. Web form requires name and state only; email confirmation loop follows submission.

peopleconnect.notes: A single opt-out at the PeopleConnect URL suppresses listings across all member brands. File once, not once per brand.
